title: Manage your tow truck operator licence
summary: This page provides information on how to manage, renew, replace, or update your tow truck operator licence.
what_you_need: For replacement: Complete the PDF form (Application for Replacement Tow Truck Operators Licence).
For replacement: Provide a photocopy of the current driver licence of the operator licence representative (both sides).
For replacement: Make the replacement payment by credit card or PayPal using the payment portal and entering the receipt number on the replacement form.

faqs.q: How do I renew my tow truck operator licence?
faqs.a: Information on renewing your licence is available on this page.

faqs.q: What do I need to do if I need to replace my licence?
faqs.a: You must complete the PDF form (Application for Replacement Tow Truck Operators Licence), provide a photocopy of the current driver licence of the operator licence representative (both sides), and make the replacement payment via credit card or PayPal.

faqs.q: How can I update my details for my licence?
faqs.a: You can email your details to towtrucks@customerservice.nsw.gov.au or post them to NSW Fair Trading, PO Box 972, Parramatta NSW 2124.
